title: Basket Random
desc: Basket Random makes basketball beautifully ridiculous. One button controls your entire ragdoll player while courts, balls and body types keep changing. Play against the CPU or a friend and be first to five baskets.
howto: Pick solo play or local two-player mode.
Use your one control to jump, flail and shoot.
Take advantage of each random court and ball type.
Defend the basket when you do not have a clean shot.
Score five times first to win the match.
tips: Let the ball settle before forcing a shot.
Use the rim as a second chance rather than a failure.
The funniest jumps often produce the best steals.
